title: Disorder-Assisted Adiabaticity in Correlated Many-Particle Systems
summary: We investigate how disorder affects adiabaticity in an interacting quantum system by assessing its effect on the state of the system after an interaction modulation, or interaction ``pulse" ,whereby the interaction is changed from zero to a maximum value and then back to zero following a given time profile. We find that, independently of the disorder strength and pulse shapes (rectangular, triangular, and Gaussian), the pulse duration is negatively correlated with the change in total energy in the system.
